name: Web Development
description: Learn the fundamentals of web development including HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

modules.name: HTML Basics
modules.article: Introduction to HTML, tags, elements and basic page structure.

modules.name: CSS Basics
modules.article: Learn CSS selectors, properties, styling and layouts.

modules.name: JavaScript Basics
modules.article: Learn JavaScript variables, functions, conditions and loops.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Explore the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and intelligent systems.

modules.name: Introduction to AI
modules.article: Learn what Artificial Intelligence is, its applications and how AI systems work.

modules.name: Machine Learning Basics
modules.article: Understand the basic concepts of machine learning, training data and models.

modules.name: AI Applications
modules.article: Explore real-world applications of AI including chatbots, recommendation systems and computer vision.

name: Database Management
description: Learn the fundamentals of databases, SQL, data management and MongoDB.

modules.name: Database Fundamentals
modules.article: Understand databases, tables, records, relationships and basic database concepts.

modules.name: SQL Basics
modules.article: Learn SQL commands for creating, reading, updating and deleting data.

modules.name: MongoDB Basics
modules.article: Introduction to MongoDB, collections, documents and basic database operations.

name: Cyber Security
description: Learn the fundamentals of cyber security, online safety and common security threats.

modules.name: Introduction to Cyber Security
modules.article: Learn the basic concepts of cyber security and why protecting digital information is important.

modules.name: Common Cyber Threats
modules.article: Understand common threats such as phishing, malware, social engineering and password attacks.

modules.name: Online Safety
modules.article: Learn practical techniques for protecting accounts, passwords, devices and personal information.
